summary: Shaheen built her 2026 NH-01 primary around opposing U.S. military aid to Israel and an anti-AIPAC stance, backing the Massie Amendment in August 2026 after earlier declining to take a position. A July 2026 C-SPAN clip title, however, stated she would not call the Gaza war a genocide. Supporting a vote to block military aid places her beyond mere humanitarian concern, yet the refusal of genocide language keeps her assessment below candidates who fully affirm that characterization.
